name: msgget
description: The msgget() system call returns the identifier for a System V message queue associated with the given key. It can be used to obtain the identifier of an existing queue or create a new one if specified in the flags.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key value used to identify or create the message queue.

parameters.name: msgflg
parameters.description: Flags that specify options for creation, exclusivity, and permissions of the message queue.

return_value.success: Returns the message queue identifier (a nonnegative integer)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: A message queue exists for the key, but the calling process lacks permission to access it.
IPC_CREAT and IPC_EXCL were specified in msgflg, but a message queue already exists for the key.
No message queue exists for the key and IPC_CREAT was not specified in msgflg.
Insufficient memory to create a new message queue.
The system limit for the maximum number of message queues would be exceeded.

bugs: The name choice IPC_PRIVATE was perhaps unfortunate, as IPC_NEW would more clearly show its function.
